want for nothing: My grandparents worked hard all their lives, so their children would want for nothing as they grew up.
我的祖父母辛苦工作了一輩子，讓他們的孩子在成長過程中什麼都不缺。
be found wanting: The old bridge was tested after the earthquake, and its safety design was found wanting in several ways.
地震後這座舊橋接受檢測，結果它的安全設計在好幾方面都被發現不合格。
wanted by the police: The man in the photo is wanted by the police for robbing three convenience stores last month.
照片中的男子因上個月搶劫三家便利商店而遭警方通緝。
want out: After two years of endless arguments, Tom told his business partner, "I want out of this company."
經過兩年無止盡的爭吵後，湯姆告訴他的事業夥伴：「我想退出這家公司。」
leave much to be wanted: The hotel looked nice online, but its cleaning service left much to be wanted during our stay.
這家飯店在網路上看起來不錯，但我們入住期間它的清潔服務有待改進。
warehouse goods: Before the holiday shopping season, the company rents extra space to warehouse goods near the harbor.
在假期購物季之前，這家公司會在港口附近租額外的空間來把貨入庫存放。
warehouse data: Large online shops warehouse data about every purchase so they can study what customers like to buy.
大型網路商店會儲存每一筆購買的數據，以便研究顧客喜歡買什麼。
a data warehouse: The bank built a data warehouse that stores millions of customer records from the past twenty years.
這家銀行建立了一個資料倉儲，儲存過去二十年來數百萬筆的客戶紀錄。
warm to an idea: At first my father refused to get a dog, but he began to warm to an idea once he saw the puppies.
一開始我爸拒絕養狗，但一看到小狗們，他就開始逐漸喜歡上這個想法。
warm up before exercise: Our coach always reminds us to warm up before exercise so that we will not hurt our muscles.
教練總是提醒我們運動前要熱身，這樣才不會拉傷肌肉。
warm up the audience: A young comedian came on stage first to warm up the audience before the famous singer appeared.
在知名歌手登場前，一位年輕喜劇演員先上台為觀眾暖場。
warm to someone: The new student was quiet at first, but the class soon began to warm to someone so kind and funny.
這位新同學一開始很安靜，但全班很快就對這位如此親切又有趣的人產生好感。
warm the heart: Stories about strangers helping each other after the typhoon always warm the heart of everyone who reads them.
颱風過後陌生人互相幫助的故事，總是溫暖每位讀者的心。
warm up leftovers: I was too tired to cook, so I decided to warm up leftovers from last night in the microwave.
我累到不想煮飯，所以決定用微波爐加熱昨晚的剩菜。
warn of danger: Signs along the beach warn of danger from strong waves, but some tourists still swim there.
海灘沿岸的告示牌警告大浪的危險，但仍有一些遊客在那裡游泳。
warn against smoking: Doctors and teachers often warn against smoking because it can cause serious lung disease later in life.
醫生和老師常告誡人們不要吸菸，因為它日後可能導致嚴重的肺病。
warn someone off: When the reporter started asking questions, the company's lawyer tried to warn someone off the story.
當記者開始提問時，公司的律師試圖警告這個人遠離這則報導。
be warned: Be warned: the trail becomes very slippery after it rains, so wear good shoes and walk slowly.
小心：下雨後這條步道會變得非常濕滑，所以要穿好鞋並慢慢走。
warn in advance: If the train schedule changes, the railway company will warn in advance through its app and website.
如果火車時刻表有變動，鐵路公司會透過它的應用程式和網站事先警告乘客。
wash one's hands of: After her brother lied to her again, Amy decided to wash her hands of his money problems.
在哥哥又一次對她說謊後，艾美決定對他的財務問題撒手不管。
wash away sins: In some religions, people believe that bathing in a holy river can wash away sins and bring peace.
在某些宗教中，人們相信在聖河中沐浴能洗清罪惡並帶來平靜。
the excuse won't wash: You have been late five times this month, and the excuse won't wash with the manager anymore.
你這個月已經遲到五次了，這個藉口對經理來說已經站不住腳了。
wash up: After every big storm, hundreds of plastic bottles wash up on the beach near our village.
每次大暴風雨過後，都有數百個塑膠瓶被沖上我們村莊附近的海灘。
wash out a game: Heavy rain is expected tomorrow afternoon, and it may wash out a game that fans have waited weeks for.
明天下午預計會下大雨，可能導致一場球迷等了好幾週的比賽因雨取消。
come out in the wash: Don't worry too much about the misunderstanding with your friend; it will all come out in the wash.
別太擔心你和朋友之間的誤會，一切終會解決的。
waste time: Don't waste time playing games on your phone when the final exam is only two days away.
期末考只剩兩天了，別再用手機玩遊戲浪費時間。
waste away: Without enough food during the long winter, the stray cat began to waste away until a family took it in.
在漫長冬天裡沒有足夠食物，這隻流浪貓開始日漸消瘦，直到一戶人家收留了牠。
waste one's breath: Don't waste your breath arguing with him; he never changes his mind once he decides something.
別白費口舌跟他爭論了；他一旦決定某件事就從不改變主意。
waste no time: As soon as the concert tickets go on sale, my sister will waste no time and buy two seats.
演唱會門票一開賣，我姊姊就會立刻買兩個座位。
waste an opportunity: Scholarships to study abroad are very hard to get, so don't waste an opportunity like this one.
出國留學的獎學金非常難拿到，所以別浪費像這樣的機會。
go to waste: Please finish your lunch, because I hate to see good food go to waste when many people are hungry.
請把午餐吃完，因為在很多人挨餓的時候，我不想看到好好的食物被浪費。
lay waste to: The powerful typhoon laid waste to the small fishing town, destroying almost every house along the coast.
這場強颱摧毀了這個小漁村，幾乎把沿岸的每一棟房子都毀了。
